name: AnxietyBuster
source:
A short game that places the player in real-life situations in which they face challenging decisions. It is up to the player to select the best option without exceeding stat levels. It is created to bring empathy and facts on anxiety. 

[From [url=https://anxietybuster.itch.io/anxietybuster]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一款简短的游戏，让玩家置身于现实生活中，面临具有挑战性的决定。玩家可以在不超过统计水平的情况下选择最佳选项。它的创建是为了带来同理心和关于焦虑的事实。

[来自[url=https://anxietybuster.itch.io/anxietybuster]Itch.io[/url]]
